relationships.subject: NGN1
relationships.evidence_quote: overexpression of NGN1 is sufficient to drive nociceptor development from NCLCs

key_findings: Robust Nav1.7 surface expression in human iPSC-derived sensory neurons requires at least 49 days of maturation in both small-molecule and NGN1 protocols.
Spontaneous electrical activity (from day 22) precedes Nav1.7 surface expression; TRPV1 and TRKA mRNA rise during differentiation.
